business_summary: Orion Group Holdings, Inc. operates as a specialty construction company for the infrastructure, industrial, and building sectors in the United States, Canada, and the Caribbean Basin. It operates through two segments, Marine and Concrete. The company engages in the building, rehabilitation, and maintenance of a range of marine transportation facilities, including terminals, cruise ship berths, private terminals, U.S. Navy facilities, marinas, and other port facilities; installation of foundations, mooring structures, and related components; provision of ongoing inspection, maintenance, and emergency repair services, as well as logistics services for directional drilling; installation and removal of underwater pipelines and transmission infrastructure, such as industrial intakes and outfalls, river crossing, and tie-ins; construction, repair, and maintenance of overwater bridges, causeways, and fendering systems; and construction of various environmental protection structures, including levees, erosion control systems, concrete mats, wetlands restoration features, and geotube installations for island and shoreline creation. It also provides maintenance and capital dredging services for ports, waterways, and channels. In addition, the company offers specialty services, such as design, salvage, demolition, surveying, towing, commercial diving, underwater inspection, excavation, and repair services. Further, it provides concrete construction services, including concrete placement and finishing, site preparation, layout, forming, and rebar placement services for data centers; industrial, warehouse, and distribution facilities; commercial, multi-family, institutional, and mixed-use structures; and retail, hospital, and recreational facilities. The company was formerly known as Orion Marine Group, Inc. and changed its name to Orion Group Holdings, Inc. in May 2016. Orion Group Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
business_summary_ko: Orion Group Holdings, Inc.는 미국, 캐나다 및 카리브해 지역의 인프라, 산업 및 건축 부문을 위한 전문 건설 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 그것은 해양과 콘크리트의 두 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 터미널, 유람선 정박지, 개인 터미널, 미 해군 시설, 선착장 및 기타 항만 시설을 포함한 다양한 해양 운송 시설의 건설, 재활 및 유지 관리에 참여하고 있습니다. 기초, 계류 구조물 및 관련 구성 요소의 설치; 지속적인 검사, 유지보수, 긴급 수리 서비스 제공 및 방향성 시추를 위한 물류 서비스 제공 산업용 취수구 및 배출구, 강 건너기 및 연결 장치와 같은 수중 파이프라인 및 송전 인프라의 설치 및 제거; 수중 교량, 둑길 및 펜더 시스템의 건설, 수리 및 유지 관리; 제방, 침식 제어 시스템, 콘크리트 매트, 습지 복원 기능, 섬 및 해안선 생성을 위한 지오튜브 설치 등 다양한 환경 보호 구조물 건설. 또한 유지 관리 및 자본 준설 서비스도 제공합니다.
